program: AU Wong Choi Full Machine Learning Program

dataset.holdout_disclosure: New to this ML run; not globally untouched because the Matrix used the archive previously.

conceptual_overlap_groups.risk: Raw official rating and its engineered 0–100 leaf encode related ability information; regularisation/trees must decide whether both add value.
Overlapping recent-form horizons can duplicate the same finishing-position signal.
Rolling outcomes overlap with the engineered consistency leaf.
Raw PF aggregates and the pace-figure leaf are related; importance must be read jointly.
Raw jockey rates partly feed the engineered jockey score.
Raw trainer rates partly feed the engineered trainer score.

champion.model: Current AU Wong Choi Rating Matrix

feature_definitions.ability_formula: sum(matrix_score * matrix_weight) + wet_form_feature; rank descending; horse number breaks exact ties

betting_rules.production: No automatic odds-based bet/stake rule in the frozen deterministic scorer; it produces rankings and confidence/radar output.
betting_rules.research_scorecard: After analysis freeze only: flat 1u Win, predicted edge >=5 percentage points, SP 1.5–50; no Place bet without historical Place dividends.
